characters.name: 林野

identity.face: angular face, sharp dark eyes, straight nose, faint scar over the right eyebrow
identity.hair: short black hair, slightly messy from sweat

characters.descriptor_en: Lin Ye (CH_LINYE_01), 19-year-old male baseball player, lean athletic build, short slightly messy black hair, sharp dark eyes, angular face, faint scar over his right eyebrow, warm tan skin, wearing a white home jersey with navy pinstripes and the number 7 on the back, navy cap, black batting gloves

home_clean.label: 主场球衣·干净
home_clean.descriptor_en: clean white home jersey with navy pinstripes and the number 7, crisp navy cap, clean white pants

home_dirty.label: 主场球衣·泥污
home_dirty.descriptor_en: white home jersey stained with infield dirt and sweat, navy cap slightly askew, muddy knees

home_injured.label: 主场球衣·受伤
home_injured.descriptor_en: dirty white home jersey, right sleeve torn at the elbow, bruised left cheek, small cut on the lower lip

continuity_rules: jersey number 7 must remain readable whenever the back is visible
dirt, injuries and the wooden bat persist across shots once introduced
hair may become messier from sweat but color and length must not change
characters.notes: 占位角色。正式设定到位后替换 identity / descriptor / 参考图；不要同时保留两套角色卡。
